 OAKLAND PARK, Fla. (Gambling911.com) - Goalscorer betting markets are available for Saturday's English Premier League match between Arsenal v Everton. 
 Players to Watch 
 Kai Havertz pays $145 for every $100 bet to score an anytime goal in this match. 
 Havertz has scored two goals in his recent ten appearances, against Chelsea on September 6 and Coventry on August 21.
 His latest performances:
- October 21 vs. Bayern Munich: 68 minutes, no goal or assist.
- October 18 vs. Nottingham Forest: 66 minutes, no goal or assist.
- October 13 vs. Lille: 25 minutes, one assist.
- October 10 vs. Leeds: 63 minutes, no goal.
- September 6 vs. Chelsea: One goal in a 2–1 victory.
 Viktor Gyökeres pays $170 for every $100 bet to score a goal on Saturday. 
 Gyökeres has been much more productive internationally than for Arsenal recently.
 His recent performances: 
- October 21 vs. Bayern Munich: One assist in 22 minutes.
- October 18 vs. Nottingham Forest: No goal in 24 minutes.
- October 13 vs. Lille: No goal in 65 minutes.
- October 10 vs. Leeds: No goal in 27 minutes.
- October 5 vs. Romania: One goal for Sweden.
- October 2 vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina: One goal.
- September 28 vs. Poland: One goal.
- September 25 vs. Romania: One goal.
 Four goals in four consecutive Sweden appearances demonstrate his scoring ability, but he has not carried that momentum into his recent Arsenal outings. 
 Eberechi Eze pays $270 for every $100 bet to score a goal Saturday. 
 Eze has scored two goals in his last three Arsenal appearances, making him the most recently productive club goalscorer of the three.
